items.extraction_note: Quote from the synthesis table of objections and proposals annexed to the draft; the speaker's comment is reported in a Government document. Reply to the proposal to raise the Labour Code's seasonal limit (Art. 279) from six to nine months; the author replied 'Se acceptă' and the Labour Code amendments were dropped from the draft. Draft Art. 42(1) keeps six months (item -0022). Added at the second-pass check (PC-05, checker-GOV8e).
